newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGB market very bubbly, risks bursting--Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: JGB market very bubbly, risks bursting--Sakakibara.

text.p: Senior Ministry of Finance (MOF) official Eisuke Sakakibara told Reuters on Friday that the Japanese government bond market is considerably "bubbly" and he sees the risk of a bursting of the bubble.

"If I put it rather harshly, the JGB market is considerably bubbly, and there is the risk of a bursting (of the bubble)," Sakakibara, director-general of the ministry's International Finance Bureau, said in an interview shown on Reuters Financial Television.

Financial markets generally think the Japanese economy is not good, he said. "However, economic data on the April-June quarter is likely to show an improvement in the economy...(and if markets do not realise this) there would be a surprise."
"I am saying that markets must be very careful. If you analyse carefully, you find there are no indicators showing the economy is worsening," he said.
